# Linkaza: The All-in-One Link Building Platform

## Overview
Linkaza is an intelligent link building platform designed to streamline SEO campaigns. It combines a massive publisher marketplace, expert content creation services, and powerful analytics into one unified dashboard. Unlike traditional agencies or SaaS tools, Linkaza operates on a pay-as-you-go model with no monthly subscriptions.

## Core Value Proposition
- **No Subscriptions:** Pay only for the backlinks ordered. No monthly platform fees.
- **Massive Inventory:** Instant access to 80,000+ vetted websites.
- **24/7 Support:** Human-powered support via live chat and email.
- **Transparency:** Full visibility on pricing, metrics (DA, DR, Traffic), and placement status.

## Main Services

### 1. Intelligent Marketplace
A searchable database of over 80,000 vetted publishers. Users can filter by:
- Niche / Industry
- Domain Authority (DA) & Domain Rating (DR)
- Organic Traffic
- Country / Region
- Price

### 2. Expert Content Creation
Linkaza offers professional SEO content writing to secure placements.
- **Standard:** High-quality grammar, SEO optimized (500+ words).
- **Business:** In-depth research, natural link placement (1000+ words).
- **Enterprise:** Subject matter expert, editorial grade (1500+ words).

### 3. Analytics & Insights
A unified dashboard to track ROI and performance.
- Live link monitoring (status, indexing).
- Anchor text distribution analysis.
- Competitor benchmarking.

### 4. Strategy Builder (Free Tool)
A free service where Linkaza's SEO experts analyze a user's site and competitors to provide a custom link building roadmap, curated domain list, and action plan.

## Solutions by Audience

### For Agencies
- **Scalability:** Manage multiple clients from one dashboard.
- **White-Label:** Reports and services designed to fit agency workflows.
- **Efficiency:** Reduces campaign execution time from hours to minutes.

### For Consultants
- **Automation:** Offloads the manual work of vetting and outreach.
- **Flexible Pricing:** Perfect for varying client budgets with zero overhead.

### For Businesses & In-House Teams
- **Control:** Direct access to premium placements without agency retainers.
- **Simplicity:** Easy-to-use interface requiring no technical SEO expertise.

### For Publishers
- **Monetization:** Website owners can list their sites to earn revenue by publishing high-quality guest content.
- **Control:** Publishers set their own prices and guidelines.

## Pricing Model
Linkaza uses a transparent **Pay-As-You-Go** model.
- **Platform Access:** Free.
- **Tools & Support:** Free.
- **Backlinks:** Prices set by publishers (ranging from $50 to $3000+).
- **Content:** Fixed fees based on word count and quality tier.
